tickets.title: API unreachable: entities/stats
tickets.text: GET http://localhost:3000/api/v1/entities/stats failed: Get "http://localhost:3000/api/v1/entities/stats": context deadline exceeded (Client.Timeout exceeded while awaiting headers)

tickets.title: Excessive white space on login page
tickets.text: There is a large amount of empty space around text fields and buttons, which makes it look disorganized.

tickets.title: Insecure Password Input
tickets.text: The password input field does not display a password visibility toggle button, which is a common UX pattern that allows users to view their password in plain text. This can lead to user frustration and potential security issues if the user enters an incorrect password multiple times.

tickets.title: Misplaced elements in sign-up form
tickets.text: The 'Sign up' button is positioned lower than the other buttons, which creates a visual disruption and might cause confusion for users. This could be due to inconsistent design choices or incorrect styling.

tickets.title: Missing Placeholder Image
tickets.text: The image placeholder is blank and does not provide a clear indication of what should be there, which can confuse users. This is an important visual cue for understanding the functionality of the page.

tickets.title: Password Input Field Does Not Display Password Strength Indicator
tickets.text: The password input field does not display a password strength indicator, which can make it difficult for users to determine if their password is strong enough.

tickets.title: Unclear Form Field Labels
tickets.text: The form fields for username and password do not have clear labels. This can cause confusion for users who may not understand what information is being requested.

tickets.title: Unclear purpose of toggle options
tickets.text: The purpose of the toggle options (Recommended, Subscriptions, and Trending) is not clear. It is not apparent what enabling or disabling these options will do for the user.
